title: Table columns do not depend on a UX level (G-18-2)
reference_behaviour: The Greeks tab and the strikewise IV panel are available to every user; no column is hidden by a level and no beginner caption replaces the headings.
ours: REQ-035 AC-7 hides IV and Greek columns at Guided and adds % return and breakevens by level; the API sends a visible flag per level. ADR-168 (4)(5) already approves removing levels; the AC is rewritten at row 17.
